races.name: Tynedale Agricultural Society Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Artiste d'Ainay
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 666-day absence which is a major concern despite decent recent form at shorter trips.

runners_data.name: Jeteye
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with solid recent form but stepping up significantly in trip having not won over this distance before.

runners_data.name: Dillarchie
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in excellent current form with two recent wins, well-suited to this intermediate trip and going conditions.

runners_data.name: Shighness

runners_data.name: Valette
runners_data.note: Prominent runner dropping significantly in grade but recent form shows declining trajectory and lacks a recent win.

runners_data.name: East Eagle
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won at this course 17 days ago over shorter distance, proven in these conditions with good tactical speed.

runners_data.name: Reagrove Lord
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 400-day layoff but gets significant weight relief at just 143lbs which could prove crucial.

runners_data.name: Twoplacesatonetime
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with inconsistent recent form but trainer Rebecca Menzies has good strike-rate with returning horses.

runners_data.name: Watchoutitscookie
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form including a win, well-suited to this trip and going combination.

runners_data.name: Seeyainthesuninn
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs strong pace to be effective but recent form suggests she's below her best level.

runners_data.name: Bray Dale
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with modest recent form but gets in light at 142lbs and has shown glimpses of ability on softer ground.

runners_data.name: My Boy Christy
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with consistent recent form including two seconds, proven at this trip and handles the going well.

races.paceDynamic: Jeteye will likely lead this field with minimal early pressure, allowing him to dictate comfortable fractions through the first circuit. The prominent runners Artiste d'Ainay, Dillarchie, Valette and Watchoutitscookie should track within striking distance but none are confirmed pressers. With such a large hold-up contingent including Shighness, East Eagle, Reagrove Lord and My Boy Christy, the pace could become pedestrian if Jeteye isn't pressed early. This tactical setup strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can stay out of trouble and avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will emerge when eight hold-up horses try to make their moves simultaneously in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Jeteye Controls Uncontested
scenarios.trigger: If Jeteye is allowed to bowl along in front without serious early pressure from the prominent brigade.
scenarios.body: He can dictate comfortable splits and prove hard to peg back up the hill, especially with the large pack of hold-up horses potentially getting in each other's way. This scenario massively favours the front-runner and any prominent tracker who can slip the field turning in.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Creates Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Dillarchie or Artiste d'Ainay decide to press Jeteye from an early stage and create a genuine tempo.
scenarios.body: The increased galloping will set up the race for the hold-up horses, particularly those with proven finishing kicks like Shighness and East Eagle. Traffic will still be an issue but the stronger pace helps sort out the field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the field settles into a pedestrian gallop with everyone waiting and watching.
scenarios.body: The finish becomes a mad sprint where positioning and luck matter more than ability, creating opportunities for unconsidered outsiders with light weights. Reagrove Lord's 143lbs could prove decisive in a rough finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Leader Folds
scenarios.trigger: If Jeteye doesn't handle the longer trip or going and begins to weaken approaching two out.
scenarios.body: This opens up tactical chaos as the prominent horses suddenly find themselves in front earlier than planned, potentially setting up a different type of finish. East Eagle's recent Hexham winner form could prove crucial.

watchPoints.text: Jeteye could get an uncontested lead and prove very hard to catch up Hexham's stiff finish, especially with eight hold-up horses potentially getting in each other's way.
Traffic problems are inevitable in the straight with so many hold-up performers needing room simultaneously - watch for those drawn high getting first run.
East Eagle's recent Hexham course win gives him a significant tactical edge over horses unfamiliar with this track's demands.
Artiste d'Ainay's 666-day absence is extreme even by comeback standards and this longer trip compounds the fitness concerns.
The 25lb weight spread from Reagrove Lord (143lbs) to Shighness (168lbs) could prove decisive if the pace becomes tactical.

races.name: Port Of Blyth Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Dream Jet
runners_data.note: Prominent runner ideally suited to race shape but the 159-day absence is a significant concern for sharpness.

runners_data.name: Chapel Green
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who should get an easy lead, though his recent pulling-up efforts raise stamina questions.

runners_data.name: Conquer The Breeze
runners_data.note: Hold-up style disadvantaged by race dynamics but his recent winning form and class make him dangerous if pace collapses.

runners_data.name: Diamond Mix
runners_data.note: Prominent style perfectly suits this tactical setup and arrives in excellent form with two recent wins.

runners_data.name: Raffles Wonder
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse faces tactical disadvantage but has solid form on similar going conditions.

runners_data.name: Don Occhetti
runners_data.note: Another hold-up runner needing pace to develop, with recent form showing inconsistency.

runners_data.name: Chumlee
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse whose style is poorly suited to this race shape and carries the longest absence.

races.paceDynamic: Chapel Green will likely set a comfortable lead with Dream Jet and Diamond Mix tracking prominently behind. With only one confirmed front-runner and most of the field content to sit off the pace, this creates a tactical race where the leaders can dictate terms without early pressure. The four hold-up horses (Conquer The Breeze, Raffles Wonder, Don Occhetti, Chumlee) will be dependent on the leaders providing something to aim at in the closing stages. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can position close to Chapel Green and avoid getting caught behind a wall of horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Chapel Green sets uncontested fractions through the early stages
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can stalk comfortably before striking, while the hold-up brigade struggle to make up ground on soft going that already favours those racing handy. Diamond Mix and Chapel Green benefit from ideal positioning.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Conquer The Breeze's class and recent winning form allows him to sweep past tiring leaders despite the tactical disadvantage. The soft ground aids his stamina but the pace scenario must fall perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Dream Jet Timing Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If Dream Jet finds his old spark after the long break
scenarios.body: The experienced gelding uses his prominent style to perfection, tracking Chapel Green before asserting in the straight. His class on his day outweighs the 159-day absence concerns.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Chapel Green stops quickly and creates a scramble
scenarios.body: Multiple hold-up horses converge simultaneously but none have the tactical advantage, leading to a messy finish where the best-positioned prominent runner prevails by default.

watchPoints.text: Chapel Green could get an uncontested lead which would be extremely difficult to peg back in this small field
Dream Jet's 159-day break means his fitness for this tactical battle is completely unknown
Conquer The Breeze needs the pace to collapse but with only Chapel Green going forward that seems unlikely
Diamond Mix is perfectly positioned to exploit this race shape from his prominent running style
The four hold-up horses could find themselves in a traffic jam behind the three prominent runners

races.name: Port Of Blyth Novices' Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Passengerontheship
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with solid recent form but needs to overcome 17-day break and step up in grade from his last second place

runners_data.name: Scairp Dubh
runners_data.note: Class act with excellent recent win and hold-up style perfectly suited to this race shape, though carries top weight at 168lbs

runners_data.name: Gone With The Tide
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who could press Lewa House but hasn't won recently and faces stronger opposition than usual

runners_data.name: Lewa House
runners_data.note: Natural front runner returning from 55-day break but has perfect 15/15 record on similar going conditions

runners_data.name: Out On Her Own
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with decent recent placings but may struggle with the stronger company after easier targets recently

runners_data.name: Reliance Kid
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with warning about fading in the finish, making him vulnerable on Hexham's demanding conclusion

runners_data.name: Tell Me Again
runners_data.note: Hold-up type from in-form Micky Hammond stable but unseated last time and needs to prove his jumping holds up

races.paceDynamic: Lewa House is the only confirmed front runner and will set a steady, uncontested lead around Hexham's demanding 2m4f circuit. Gone With The Tide may press forward but lacks the pace to challenge early leadership. The absence of pace pressure allows Lewa House to dictate fractions, creating a tactical race where the field bunches approaching the business end. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, particularly those with stamina reserves for Hexham's stiff finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Lewa House gets an easy time in front and the field allows comfortable fractions
scenarios.body: The 10-year-old veteran controls the race from the front and uses his 15/15 soft ground record to repel late challenges. Hold-up horses struggle to peg back the advantage on the testing Hexham finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace allows closers to get into striking position turning for home
scenarios.body: Scairp Dubh or Passengerontheship unleash finishing kicks that overhaul Lewa House in the final furlong. The sustainable fractions play perfectly into the hands of horses with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Gone With The Tide sits close to Lewa House and outbattles him from the last fence
scenarios.body: The 7-year-old uses his prominent running style to stay within striking distance before wearing down the leader. His trainer Alison Hamilton's 1/2 recent form suggests shrewd placement.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Lewa House stops quickly after a long lay-off and the race falls apart
scenarios.body: The 55-day break tells on the leader and creates a scramble where any of the hold-up horses can pick up the pieces. Tell Me Again or Out On Her Own capitalize on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Lewa House jumping - any early mistakes could derail his front-running tactics and hand initiative to Gone With The Tide
Scairp Dubh getting competitive position - if caught too far back early, even his class may not overcome Hexham's stiff finish
Gone With The Tide's early positioning - needs to be close enough to Lewa House to mount realistic challenge but not too keen
Tell Me Again's jumping confidence after his last unseat - any hesitation will cost him vital ground in small field
Weather conditions on the day - any further rain could emphasize stamina over speed and help Lewa House's cause further

races.paceDynamic: The Clonmel Kid and Kells Priory lead the prominent group with Katie's Melody and Worth The Walk also likely to race handily, creating a competitive early pace over this extended trip. With five hold-up horses including Milan Milos, Dr Shirocco, and West Lawn tracking behind, the tempo should be genuine but not excessive early on. The pace will build through the middle stages as the prominent runners maintain position, before the hold-up horses launch their challenges from the final mile. This race shape favours hold-up performers who can time their run perfectly, as the prominent group will soften each other up over the demanding three-mile journey.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group set a strong gallop and tire late
scenarios.body: The sustained pace over three miles will perfectly suit the patient tactics of Milan Milos and Dr Shirocco. Their fresh finishing kicks will overwhelm the front-runners who've done too much work.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners sustain
scenarios.trigger: If The Clonmel Kid and Katie's Melody can control the tempo
scenarios.body: A more measured early pace allows the leaders to conserve energy for a sprint finish. The class and recent form of The Clonmel Kid becomes decisive against tiring hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Killybegs Jet Lady surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The light weight and tactical speed of Killybegs Jet Lady proves ideal in a slowly-run race. Her recent course form and apprentice claim become significant advantages in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace duel ruins chances
scenarios.trigger: If The Clonmel Kid and Katie's Melody clash early
scenarios.body: An unsustainable gallop from the prominent pair opens the door for outsiders. The consistent Dr Shirocco and improving West Lawn benefit from the suicidal pace up front.

watchPoints.text: Monitor how aggressively The Clonmel Kid and Katie's Melody dispute the early lead as a pace duel could ruin both chances
Watch for Milan Milos to be produced with a late run from the rear as his class could prove decisive if others tire
Killybegs Jet Lady's jumping needs scrutiny given her inconsistent record and the pressure of racing prominently
Check if Dr Shirocco gets the patient ride his hold-up style demands rather than being committed too early
Observe whether the 3lb claiming jockeys on Killybegs Jet Lady, West Lawn and Worth The Walk handle the tactical pressure

runners_data.name: Mister St Eloi
runners_data.note: Unraced style creates uncertainty but Sean Bowen booking suggests stable confidence, though 443 days since last appearance is concerning

runners_data.name: Coniston Commander
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent fourth-place efforts suggest he's struggling to recapture best form despite suitable going conditions

runners_data.name: Rachel Lopez
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with 7lb weight advantage and solid recent second at Hexham, but needs strong pace to be effective

runners_data.name: Passing Diamond
runners_data.note: Proven front-runner who won at this track 17 days ago and should dictate ideal fractions with no pace pressure expected

races.paceDynamic: Passing Diamond is the only confirmed pace-setter and should dictate comfortable fractions from the front, with Bold Step likely to track in second through the early stages. The hold-up horses Coniston Commander and Rachel Lopez will need the pace to be strong enough to set up their finishing kicks, but with just one leader this looks unlikely to develop into a truly searching gallop. This tactical setup clearly favours the front-running and prominent racers who can control the tempo and avoid relying on a potentially inadequate pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Passing Diamond gets an easy lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: His recent Hexham win shows he handles the track, and with no pace pressure he can time his effort perfectly while the hold-up horses struggle to peg him back. Bold Step becomes the main danger if tracking him closely throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Bold Step gets a perfect stalking trip behind Passing Diamond
scenarios.body: The Henderson-trained gelding can use his class advantage and Bowen's tactical nous to strike at the optimum moment when the leader tires. This becomes a battle between the two pace-focused runners.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes stronger than expected with Bold Step pressing Passing Diamond
scenarios.body: Rachel Lopez could benefit from a truly-run race given her recent good form and 7lb weight advantage. Coniston Commander's poor recent efforts make him less likely to capitalize even if the pace suits.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mister St Eloi Upset
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced Murphy runner has improved significantly from his debut second
scenarios.body: His unknown style and potential improvement curve could catch out more exposed rivals, particularly with Sean Bowen's booking suggesting confidence. However, the lack of form evidence makes this a speculative outcome.

watchPoints.text: Passing Diamond could get too easy a lead if Bold Step doesn't track him closely enough through the early stages
Mister St Eloi's lengthy absence of 443 days makes him vulnerable despite potential improvement from Murphy stable
Rachel Lopez needs the pace to be stronger than expected given only one confirmed leader in the field
Coniston Commander's recent poor form suggests he may struggle even if pace dynamics suit his hold-up style
Bold Step's 130-day break could blunt his finishing kick despite the strong Henderson preparation

races.paceDynamic: Double Digits will lead from the start with Thewoodcorner and Wee Alki likely to track him in prominent positions early. The large field of hold-up horses (Sunset Hill, Balboa, Red Cadillac, That One, Banderas, Divilabother) will create traffic problems as they all need room to challenge late. Double Digits faces minimal early pressure and can dictate a steady tempo before the field converges. This race shape strongly favours the early leaders and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic chaos behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Double Digits Dictates
scenarios.trigger: If Double Digits gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: He faces no early pace pressure and can time his effort perfectly while the hold-up brigade get tangled up behind. His front-running style lets him avoid all traffic issues in a crowded field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pairs Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Thewoodcorner and Wee Alki track Double Digits and strike turning in
scenarios.body: They get first run on the field while avoiding the scramble for racing room that will engulf the back markers. Their prominent positioning gives them a crucial tactical edge over superior-rated hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Deliver
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and gaps appear for the closers in the straight
scenarios.body: The quality hold-up horses like Sunset Hill and Balboa get clear runs and their superior ratings tell. Red Cadillac's excellent soft ground record makes him dangerous if finding daylight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or a crawling pace creates an unusual race dynamic
scenarios.body: The tactical disadvantages are neutralized and an outsider with reasonable form gets through. Well Educated's light weight becomes a factor if the race falls apart.

watchPoints.text: Double Digits could steal this if getting soft lead with no early pace pressure from 12 hold-up horses
Traffic problems inevitable in straight as Sunset Hill, Balboa, Red Cadillac and Banderas all need room simultaneously
Thewoodcorner and Wee Alki gain crucial tactical edge by avoiding the hold-up horse scramble
Well Educated's 206-day break makes fitness a major question despite light weight
Ground officially soft but appears riding slower based on going reports, favouring proven soft ground horses

races.paceDynamic: Allbetsoff and Malangen will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front runners likely to post honest fractions in this 2m hurdle. The pace shouldn't be extreme but will be solid enough to test stamina reserves, particularly with Allbetsoff returning from a 170-day break and needing the run. Fine Point and Justus should track the leaders prominently, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Western Soldier, Interchangeable, and Fairly Fulling will look to time their challenges from off the pace. This honest gallop strongly favours the prominent racers and those with tactical speed to position close to the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is honest but not punishing enough to stop the early leaders completely
scenarios.body: Fine Point and Justus can track the pace setters and have enough tactical speed to strike when the front runners tire. Their prominent style perfectly suits a race where positioning near the pace proves crucial.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Artists Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Allbetsoff and Malangen go too fast early and crumble in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of Western Soldier and Fairly Fulling pay dividends as they sweep past tired leaders. Western Soldier's course form (1W2P from 9 runs) and Fairly Fulling's recent win give them the edge in a cavalry charge finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Malangen gets an easy lead with Allbetsoff not firing fresh from his break
scenarios.body: The 11-year-old can dictate terms from the front and prove hard to peg back despite his modest rating. His recent placed efforts and quick return suggest he's in form and the 3lb claimer helps significantly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Upset from Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and it becomes a sprint finish favouring fresh legs
scenarios.body: Blue Bear's light weight (148lbs) and recent run could see him sneak up the inner as others tire. His hold-up style works best in a slowly-run race that becomes tactical.

watchPoints.text: Allbetsoff may not fire fresh from his 170-day absence and could set this up for others if he leads and stops quickly.
Fine Point wears headgear for the first time which could spark improvement or cause distraction in a tactical finish.
The large number of hold-up horses (6 of 10) could create traffic problems if they all come with late runs together.
Malangen's 11-year-old legs may not sustain a bold front-running bid over this trip despite his recent form.
Western Soldier's course specialists could have a significant edge given his excellent Hexham record of 1W2P from 9 attempts.
